messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas closing my eyes and wondering why chocolate was so secretive.

output.original_text: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas closing my eyes and wondering why chocolate was so secretive.
output.joy: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, eyes closed, grinning as I wondered why chocolate was so delightfully secretive!
output.sadness: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, eyes closed, feeling a bit lost as I wondered why chocolate was so secretive.
output.fear: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, eyes shut tight, feeling uneasy as I wondered why chocolate had to be so secretive.
output.anger: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, closing my eyes, frustrated and seething over why chocolate was so secretive.
output.surprise: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, eyes closed, suddenly struck with wonder about why chocolate was so mysterious!
output.disgust: I remember sitting on the bed in my pajamas, closing my eyes, recoiling at the bizarre secrecy surrounding chocolate.
